description: Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel meets tech leaders in the US to promote the state as a hub for AI and semiconductors.
body_lead: Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel on Wednesday stepped up the state’s engagement with global technology companies, meeting senior leaders from Micron, Google and Perplexity AI during the third day of his US visit ahead of the Vibrant Gujarat Summit 2027. Patel’s meetings with Micron chairman and CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, Google vice president Chandu Thota and Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas focused on semiconductors, artificial intelligence, data infrastructure, skilling and potential investments in Gujarat.
